note: Laurus reports one operating segment but discloses divisional revenue every quarter: CDMO (small molecules + Bio) and Affordable Medicines (API + FDF), plus ARV revenue (API + FDF combined). Annual FY20-FY24 divisional figures are read from the company's Sep-2026 investor presentation charts and reconciled to reported revenue (Bio by difference); FY25-FY26 are tabled in the Q4FY26 presentation. Quarterly Q4FY25-Q1FY27 are from the Q4FY26 and Q1FY27 presentations; Q1-Q3FY25 small molecules from Choice (26-Jul-2026), API and FDF back-calculated from MOSL's FY26 year-on-year growth rates (24-Jul-2026) and Bio by difference (all reconcile to the company's FY25 totals). Gross margin = company; EBITDA margin = Screener basis (before other income).
